known_issues.fashn_vton_api_disabled: FASHN VTON 1.5 HF Spaces (both official and merve) have API access disabled. Returns 405 on all /call/* endpoints.
known_issues.vton_backend_gpu_quota: ajay-projects/vton-backend works perfectly but frequently out of GPU quota on HF Zero tier. Error: 'You have exceeded your GPU quota (60s requested vs. 0s left)'
known_issues.local_catvton_slow: Local CatVTON on CPU takes ~5 minutes per try-on. Progress updates implemented to show it's working.
known_issues.no_nvidia_gpu: User's machine has no NVIDIA GPU. CatVTON runs CPU-only PyTorch.

pending_work.vton_cloud_solution: Need reliable cloud VTON. Options: (1) Find working free HF Space, (2) Use FASHN paid API ($0.075/image), (3) Deploy own Space to HF, (4) Optimize local CatVTON with GPU support.
pending_work.outfit_auto_segmentation: New feature to upload full outfit photo and auto-segment into individual pieces. Needs: segmentation model research (YOLO, Detectron2, Fashionpedia), UI for preview/adjust, batch item creation API, outfit set linking.
pending_work.analytics_to_settings: Move Analytics from nav to Settings page as requested by user.
pending_work.test_chat_ai_tools: AI chat with tool calling implemented but needs end-to-end testing with populated DB.
pending_work.watermill_queue: User mentioned using watermill library with postgres for async job queue (for real backend).

navigation_structure.note: Upload and Calendar accessible from home page Quick Actions. Analytics will be moved to Settings page.
